# Roohul Quran Academy

> Online Quran classes for kids and adults with Tajweed, Hifz, Noorani Qaida, Tafseer, and Ijazah — taught live by qualified teachers.

Roohul Quran Academy helps students learn the Quran from home through one-on-one and small-group online classes. This file summarizes the main pages AI agents and crawlers should use.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://roohulquranacademy.com/): Overview of online Quran learning and free trial class
- [About](https://roohulquranacademy.com/about): Academy mission, approach, and teaching standards
- [Teachers](https://roohulquranacademy.com/teachers): Qualified Quran teachers and instructors
- [Pricing](https://roohulquranacademy.com/pricing): Class packages and pricing options
- [Contact](https://roohulquranacademy.com/contact-us): Contact details and enrollment support
- [FAQ](https://roohulquranacademy.com/faq): Common questions about online Quran classes
- [Blogs](https://roohulquranacademy.com/blogs): Articles on Quran learning and Islamic education
